title: The Moving Sofa Problem
exact_target: Find the greatest area of a single rigid planar shape that can be carried continuously around a right angle in a hallway of width one, and identify a shape attaining it.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 33 (GEO-004). CC BY 4.0.
Jineon Baek, Optimality of Gerver’s Sofa, arXiv:2411.19826v1 (2024), Definitions 1.1.1--1.1.3 and Theorem 1.1.1.
